manual.hf_gain_exact_wording: Adjusts the amount of damping applied to the high-frequency range.
manual.lf_gain_exact_wording: Adjusts the amount of damping applied to the low-frequency range.
manual.observation: Frequencies delimit the low/high range being reduced. HIGH CUT separately controls treble reduction. No internal placement or per-loop attenuation is specified.

club.note_offs: Unrecovered; these are source level/spectrum breaks, not authenticated MIDI release times. Stored AMP release0 and no active delay improve conditional reverb attribution.
club.later_gaps: Additional checks retained unchanged. Waveform similarity0.724/0.399 to first tail does not establish independent performance, and no scalar gain was fitted.
club.ending: Final direct sound remains until around29.94s; only about0.3s of residual is available before the30.2498s file end and terminal digital zeros. The terminal side-energy behavior differs markedly from earlier tails. This is unsuitable for a sustained tail slope; the zeros may include codec padding and do not independently identify an edit, gate, FX switch or fade.
club.active_patch: Dual layers; both centered, both AMP release0. Only Upper sends to reverb50; Lower0. Delay switch off despite stored sends. Upper drive70, cutoffLFO34; no dry-note constant-spectrum assertion.

ambient.note_offs: Unrecovered. Continuing side lobes and harmonic groups can include AMP release and active delay, even after the conservative direct-level decline.
ambient.delay: Both sends40, feedback+20%, TIMEraw83, HF DAMPraw9=1600Hz; no delay-time conversion or decay fit.
ambient.ending: Lower-band energy persists while upper bands approach same-file quiet level; selected support ends before final near-floor/codec padding. Smooth mastering fade cannot be excluded.
ambient.active_patch: Dual centered layers. Upper square pair driven30, AMP23/72/118/30; Lower sine pair AMP76/127/100/22. Reverb sends43/112. Stored filter and layer release behavior remains a confound.

feasibility.answer: Neither selected late-tail support identifies HF damping above the4kHz corner. Club supports conditional low-band reverb-tail checks; Ambient supports conditional combined-effects checks.
feasibility.coverage_scope: Both training/check and stereo/mid/side must exceed frozen20dB opening-quiet band guard. Check per-channel tables; this is descriptive detectability, not calibrated SNR or a perceptual threshold.
feasibility.future_protocol: Keep frozen intervals and all later-gap/low-level diagnostics. Do not select new intervals by candidate fit. Any later damping hypothesis must account for initial spectral state, direct release, excitation history, delay and common output/capture filtering; no direct cross-preset attenuation division because TIME77/89 and source spectra differ.
